title.narrative: Multi-Sectoral intervention FSA, Shelter, for underserved vulnerable communities in Rural Aleppo, Dara, and DEZ

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtRescate's response aligns with the 1st SA strategy, focusing on providing integrated, multi-sectoral solutions to address immediate critical needs and build resilience. ltbrgtBefore submitting the project, Rescate coordinated with the relevant sectors, sub-sectors, and DINGO, receiving approval for the proposal activities. Rescate is currently working on CFW and shelter projects in previously served areas, targeting sub-districts from the 1st SA prioritized list with a severity 4 score, which are underserved since IDPs and refugees returned.ltbrgtUnder FSA efforts to ensure food chain efficiency in Rural Aleppo, Kwaires, Rescate, following FSA Strategic Priority 2, Build resilience against the impact of the socio-economic crisis for the most vulnerable populations in underserved locations affected by conflict, displacement, and natural shocks through services and alternative livelihood opportunities, will supply essential seeds and fertilizers for the winter wheat planting season and cover land plowing/reclamation costs for one hectare per HH/farmer. Some 160 farmers will handle sowing, weeding, harvesting, and transporting tasks. This intervention will secure long-term jobs for the community in Kwaires. Rescate will also support the food chain by rehabilitating the Zarbah bakery, which provides subsidized bread to 12 adjacent villages. The bakery, registered with the Bakeries Directorate in Aleppo, hence will receive operational support including fuel, flour, and yeast which ensures long term bread distribution to 24000 population. ltbrgtIn Dara, where Rescate worked on FSA projects in 2022, the Dara Mills Directorate has requested Rescate's assistance in urgently rehabilitating the Grain Receiving Center (Qaban) for installing a solar power system, under Market and Value Chain Support. This intervention will secure jobs throughout the storage period and later transportation upon supplying in addition to storage of grains in nearby location when grains needed in Dara.ltbrgtIn DEZ, Rescate has rehabilitated water and sanitation lines. Currently, communities have reached out to Rescate representatives under the CFW Solid Waste and Debris Management project asking for support with ltbrgtshelter intervention for vulnerable HHs in Hameidiyyeh in line with subnational sector priorities to facilitate normalcy of life in the neighborhoods. ltbrgtlt/pgt
